questions.question: What do current online reviews say about the Keychron K8 Pro and Royal Kludge RK61? Compare them and cite the source URLs you used.
questions.content:
**Keychron K8 Pro** – what the sourced reviews say  
- The JonsDocs review (Feb 2024) notes a solid build (≈1 kg, sturdy box), hot‑swappable Gateron G Pro brown switches, a 4000 mAh battery that offers ~100 h of Bluetooth + RGB use, and a useful Fn‑layer for macros. The reviewer likes the back‑lit keys, the dedicated screenshot button and finds the keyboard “happy” after a week of daily use, though a wrist‑rest is advisable because the board is a bit tall. **Source:** https://blog.jonsdocs.org.uk/2024/02/10/review-keychron-k8-pro-part-1/  

- The Keyboards Lab review (Apr 2024) describes the K8 Pro as a versatile 87‑key TKL with hot‑swappable Gateron G Pro or Keychron K Pro switches, double‑shot PBT keycaps, and a 4000 mAh rechargeable battery (≈100 h with Bluetooth + RGB). It praises the robust aluminum/ABS frame, VIA‑based remapping, and good N‑Key rollover, but points out “poor Bluetooth performance” and “high latency” for the reviewer, plus that the keycaps can be hard to read in low light. **Source:** https://keyboardslab.com/keychron-k8-pro-review/  

**Royal Kludge RK61** – the provided URLs did not include any review content for this model, so no sourced statements can be given about its online reviews.  

**Cited URLs** (each used as a source):  
https://blog.jonsdocs.org.uk/2024/02/10/review-keychron-k8-pro-part-1/  
https://keyboardslab.com/keychron-k8-pro-review/
